items.title: AI热潮点燃金属需求，市场预测铜今年仍将供不应求
items.raw_excerpt: 自2025年初以来，MSCI金属与矿业指数累计上涨近90%，大幅跑赢半导体、全球银行以及“美股七巨头”。而随着机器人、电动汽车以及人工智能（AI）数据中心的快速发展不断将金属价格推向新高，这波行情丝毫没有停歇迹象。根据一项市场预测，今年铜仍将供不应求，供应缺口甚至可能比2025年更加严重。在黄金方面，BI分析师认为金价可能上探每盎司5000美元，而高盛集团则预计到2026年底金价将达到5400美元，较当前水平仍有约8%的上涨空间。

title_i18n.zh: AI热潮点燃金属需求，市场预测铜今年仍将供不应求
title_i18n.en: The AI boom is fueling demand for metals, with market forecasts indicating that copper will remain in short supply this year.
title_i18n.es: El auge de la IA enciende la demanda de metales, y el mercado prevé que el cobre seguirá enfrentando escasez de oferta este año.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 自2025年初以来，MSCI金属与矿业指数累计上涨近90%，大幅跑赢半导体、全球银行以及“美股七巨头”。而随着机器人、电动汽车以及人工智能（AI）数据中心的快速发展不断将金属价格推向新高，这波行情丝毫没有停歇迹象。根据一项市场预测，今年铜仍将供不应求，供应缺口甚至可能比2025年更加严重。在黄金方面，BI分析师认为金价可能上探每盎司5000美元，而高盛集团则预计到2026年底金价将达到5400美元，较当前水平仍有约8%的上涨空间。
excerpt_i18n.en: Since the beginning of 2025, the MSCI Metals and Mining Index has surged nearly 90%, significantly outperforming semiconductors, global banks, and the "Magnificent Seven" U.S. stocks. With the rapid development of robotics, electric vehicles, and AI data centers continuously driving metal prices to new highs, this rally shows no signs of slowing. According to a market forecast, copper is expected to remain in a supply deficit this year, with the shortfall potentially even more severe than in 2025. Regarding gold, BI analysts suggest prices could reach $5,000 per ounce, while Goldman Sachs Group projects gold to hit $5,400 by the end of 2026, representing an approximate 8% increase from current levels.
excerpt_i18n.es: Desde principios de 2025, el índice MSCI de metales y minería ha acumulado un aumento de casi el 90%, superando ampliamente a los sectores de semiconductores, banca global y las "siete grandes" acciones estadounidenses. Con el rápido desarrollo de robots, vehículos eléctricos y centros de datos de inteligencia artificial impulsando continuamente los precios de los metales a nuevos máximos, esta tendencia no muestra señales de detenerse. Según una previsión de mercado, el cobre seguirá enfrentando escasez de oferta este año, y el déficit podría ser incluso más grave que en 2025. En cuanto al oro, los analistas de BI consideran que su precio podría alcanzar los 5000 dólares por onza, mientras que Goldman Sachs prevé que llegue a 5400 dólares para finales de 2026, lo que supone un potencial de alza de aproximadamente el 8% desde los niveles actuales.

items.title: AI agent that searches the Cursor forum
items.raw_excerpt:
I built an AI agent that searches the entire Cursor community forum ( http://forum.cursor.com/ ) and answers questions grounded in real forum discussions. The problem: Cursor's forum has tons of valuable content - feature discussions, troubleshooting threads, tips from power users - but it's hard to search. Traditional forum search is keyword-based and misses a lot of context. The solution: I indexed the entire forum using Nia (a knowledge indexing service) and connected it to an AI agent with multiple search tools: - Semantic search - finds relevant posts even when wording differs
- Pattern search (grep) - exact matching for error messages, usernames, specific terms
- Full thread reading - AI can dive deep into specific discussions
- Web search fallback - for questions the forum doesn't c

items.title: StormWatch – Weather emergency dashboard with prep checklists
items.raw_excerpt:
Basically was getting annoyed jumping between 5 different sites during this winter storm season, so I built "StormWatch". It's a no-fuss, mobile-friendly webpage (dashboard) that shows all the stuff I was looking for, but in one simple UI. Features: - Real-time NWS alerts with safety tips
- Snow/ice/precip accumulation forecasts (+wind)
- Dynamic preparation checklists based on your alerts
- Supply calculator for your household size
- Regional weather news It's free, no login required, works on any device. Just enter your ZIP. https://jeisey.github.io/stormwatch/ Uses NWS and GDELT APIs and open source. Feel free to fork and modify however you'd like. For builders:
- Used an API-testing agent to verify all endpoints, response patterns, types, and rate limits
- Used a scope & validation age
